texts.zh:
方舟舰[Root.GetName]上正在开展常规审计，结果发现了货物记录中存在差异。

监控录像显示，方舟舰居民中已经形成了一个非正式的交换网络。一个以物易物的系统在船员和定居者之间悄然兴起。易腐物品、工具、奢侈品和个人服务在监控有限的僻静角落被进行交易。

这一发现引发了一些令人不安的问题。有人赞赏其中展现出的聪明才智；而另一些人则警告说，方舟舰上的任何监管疏忽都可能带来严重的风险。
texts.en:
A routine audit aboard Arkship [Root.GetName] has uncovered discrepancies in our cargo records.

Security footage indicates the formation of an informal exchange network among the Arkship's residents. A barter system has quietly emerged among crew and civilians. Perishables, tools, luxury goods, and personal services are traded in secluded corners where surveillance is limited.

The discovery raises uncomfortable questions. Some admire the ingenuity on display. Others warn that any lapse in oversight aboard an Arkship could carry serious risks.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这艘舰船的名称。
note.en: In the game, this ship's name appears here.

texts.zh:
方舟舰内部的非法以物易物网络已被证明极其稳定。尽管缺乏官方监管，该网络通过信任和相互依赖实现了自我调节。纠纷鲜少发生，且在方舟舰正式分配系统难以维持进度时，必需品仍能持续流通。通过将此类交易合法化并建立清晰的界限，方舟舰在其内部接纳了有限的自由市场。

对许多居民而言，这一改变不仅提供了获取商品的途径，还赋予了他们在方舟舰庞大体制内的自主权、责任感以及焕发出的使命感。
texts.en:
The unauthorized barter network within the Arkship has proven remarkably stable. Despite the lack of official oversight, the network has regulated itself through trust and mutual dependence. Disputes are rare, and essential goods continue to circulate where the Arkship's formal distribution systems struggle to keep pace. By legalizing the exchanges and establishing clear boundaries, the Arkship embraced a limited free market within its walls.

For many residents, the change offers more than access to goods. It provides agency, responsibility, and a renewed sense of purpose within the vast machinery of the Arkship.

texts.zh:
方舟舰维护通道内的以物易物网络展现出了惊人的效率。货物持续通过非官方渠道流通，填补了方舟舰配给系统中微小但持续存在的缺口。

某些中间人已受到秘密接触，他们通过提供合作来换取免受执法干扰。每笔交易中都有一小部分份额流入了我们的官方账户。对居民而言，该市场仍处于非官方状态，且在很大程度上避开了当局的视线。然而在实际操作中，其流量均在严密监控之下，且利润丰厚。
texts.en:
The barter network operating within the Arkship's maintenance corridors has proven surprisingly efficient. Goods continue to circulate through unofficial channels, filling small but persistent gaps in the Arkship's distribution systems.

Certain intermediaries have been discreetly approached and offered protection from enforcement in return for cooperation. A modest share of each transaction now finds its way back into our official accounts. To the residents, the market remains unofficial and largely invisible to authority. In practice, however, its flows are carefully observed and surprisingly profitable.

label.en: If trade flows, so will revenue.
Taxation is the price of prosperity.

texts.zh:
该非法市场已成功关闭。我们的安保团队已开始拆除相关网络。用于交易的储物柜已被封存，且低能见度区域的监控范围也已扩大。那些组织交易的人员已被正式调岗或受到纪律处分。

虽然这种以物易物的网络曾给部分居民带来了一种自主感和机遇感，但方舟舰的设计初衷绝非支持非官方的分配方式。在一艘每一份资源都必须记录在案的舰船上，管控与可预测性始终是重中之重。
texts.en:
The unauthorized market was shut down successfully. Our security teams have begun dismantling the network. Storage lockers used for trading have been sealed, and surveillance expanded in the low-visibility areas. Those organizing exchanges have been formally reassigned or received disciplinary actions.

While the barter network had provided some residents with a sense of autonomy and opportunity, the Arkship was never designed to support unofficial means of distribution. On a vessel where every resource must be accounted for, control and predictability remain of highest importance.

# 不受监管的贸易 / Unregulated Trade

- 分类 Category：银河轶事 C8 stories · 来源 Sources：events/nomads_arkship_events.txt、common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt、common/special_projects/06_projects_nomads.txt、common/event_chains/00_event_chains_nomads.txt · 游牧帝国内容 nomad content · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

游牧帝国的方舟随机事件：隐藏事件 arkship.1（nomads_arkship_events.txt:7-49）定期检查，游戏前5年不会发生，每次约三分之一几率（中期前×1.5；近期参战或所有方舟都在战斗时为0）调用 generate_arkship_event 从 mobile_arkship_random_events 池（00_on_actions.txt:3979-4006，24项，总权重460）中抽取一件，否则3–5年后再试。多数事件设置一次性标记（个别如“出发！”可发生两次）；结束后约10–15年再重新开始检查。（池中权重 20/460，00_on_actions.txt:3999）
Nomad arkship random event: hidden arkship.1 (nomads_arkship_events.txt:7-49) checks periodically — never in the first 5 years, about one in three (×1.5 before mid game, 0 during recent war or when every arkship is fighting) — and draws one episode from mobile_arkship_random_events (00_on_actions.txt:3979-4006, 24 entries, total weight 460); otherwise it retries in 3–5 years. Most episodes set a once-only flag (Start Your Engines can happen twice); after it ends the loop resumes roughly 10–15 years later. (pool weight 20/460, 00_on_actions.txt:3999)

条件：非格式塔；只发生一次。
Conditions: non-gestalt; once.

  An informal barter network: legalise (A Free Market), tax (Death and Taxes) or shut it down (Control Regained).
